fact: The case study states that Koidu Government Hospital in Kono uses the PIH EMR, an OpenMRS distribution, for mental health, triage, vitals, non-communicable diseases and maternal and child health, that the EMR was introduced to its maternity ward in July 2025, and that the Maternal Center of Excellence on the hospital campus opened on 14 February 2026 with the EMR across all inpatient wards; Wellbody Clinic has used the PIH EMR since 2015, in nearly every department since 2020.
title: PIH EMR Maternal Center of Excellence Case Study
